canon_hash_layout: FNV-1a-64 over each record in file order: little-endian int64 id, float64 x_m, y_m, z_m, dx, dy, dz, ekin_gev, int32 pdg
float_format: std::to_chars shortest round-trip; LF line endings
generator: legacy PrimaryGeneratorAction::GeneratePrimaries (unchanged) called for each G4Event(id); the primary is read back from the event

rng.engine: CLHEP::MixMaxRng (private instance, installed with G4Random::setTheEngine for generation only)

units.id: Geant4 event ID, rows 0..n-1 in order
units.position: m, world frame (cone axis at the origin, ground at z = 0)
